integrity: Every universal conclusion is deduced analytically. Numerical consistency checks are finite and do not constitute mathematical or bibliographic certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to normalized planar area on concentric annuli and the orthogonal degree-one affine projector only. The circle at inner radius 1 is a limit. No analogous result is asserted for shifted holes, higher degrees, or weighted domains; bibliographic priority has not been independently established.
title: Strict hole-radius stabilization and a 5/2-cusp for the annular affine projector
